x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.guidance_text: Apply provisional credit within 10 business days of a disputed electronic transaction if the investigation is not complete. Resolve within 45 days (90 for new accounts / POS / foreign). Notify the customer when credit is applied.
x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.keywords: Reg E, provisional credit, 10 business days, 45 days, EFTA
